event_chain.summary: Pretexting - fake vendor EFT change form from compromised vendor email
Fraudulent transaction - payment diverted to attacker account

summary: In April 2026 criminals used an email account compromised within vendor Traffic Control Devices' systems to send the City of Ocala, Florida a doctored Electronic Fund Transfer form with altered banking details. A city vendor relationship employee entered the new bank details without the required phone verification, and $492,056 was diverted to the attacker's account. The receiving bank flagged suspicious activity in May; the bank recovered $214,256 and insurance covered $250,000, leaving a net city loss of $27,799.81. An investigation found the incident preventable and the FBI took the case.
